title: Has anyone ever had this happened to them
content: Lastnight i dreamed of the old place where I used to live same street same old freeway over same old vehicles that are always in the dream almost the same people and I'm usually always trying to exit to the street but I always end up at the entrance for one reason or another but lastnight I did see familiar faces and one of them looked at me and called out my name i dint react to it and just keep walking has anyone ever experienced this before?
